note: Powered hold, hit while carrying (recorded as sled-8g-into-nip, G3): 8 g for 50 ms into the held nip.

assumes.text: The pipe arrives square to the chute and stays square, its axis across the robot.

The robot's pipe-contact surfaces are the contact lines of the pocket section (inlet, floor, hood, flare and lip), typed from the design's parameters; the drawn solids sit 2.5 mm (lip 3.5 mm) below them as the clearance reserve.
Each roller is its 2 in tread circle on the axis the parameters place, with the tread's compliance as its contact spring; the drawn roller solid is only the rigid core, so the tread is typed.

The pipe starts at rest where the nominal trial before it left it, whatever the tread stiffness of this run; the recorded campaign started each stiffness at its own receive seat (304.10 to 308.57 mm).
The robot's acceleration is a load on the pipe in the robot frame; the robot does not pitch.
